environment.description: Same application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has AWS WAF v2 WebACL attached with two rule groups: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING rule in COUNT mode and all other rules in BLOCK mode, (2) a custom rule group with a single RegexPatternSet rule that inspects SingleQueryArgument 'value' and blocks requests matching pattern `(?i)(?:union\s+select|;\s*(?:drop|insert|update|delete|alter)|'\s*or\s+'|'\s*--)|(?:\x27|%27)(?:\s|%20)*(?:or|and|union)` with action BLOCK and priority 1. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. CloudWatch metrics confirm the custom rule fires on SQL metacharacter patterns in the 'value' parameter.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALB with WAF v2 WebACL association

waf_web_acl_rules.name: AWS-AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet
waf_web_acl_rules.note: SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING in COUNT mode, all others BLOCK

config.database: SQLite at /var/data/users.db (ephemeral Fargate storage, seeded on startup)
